title: NightWatch Policy Decision
description: C04 product: policy decision with expiry (approved/denied + reason + record + expiry). Source: WorkRequest §5.2, §5.10 C04. RUNTIME SEMANTIC: expired decisions are rejected by default, never auto-extended (§22.5.4).
x-nightwatch-runtime-semantics: Expired decisions are rejected, not auto-extended.

reason.description: Why the decision was reached (environment class, budget, destructive/load limits...).

requested_action.description: The action the decision applies to, e.g. 'run.execute:environment=production'.

decided_by.description: Policy actor: automated policy engine id or human approver id.

expires_at.description: Mandatory expiry; approvals/decisions must carry an expiry time (§22.5.4).

conditions.description: Conditions attached to an approval (e.g. max request budget).
